comments.author: @jacquelineblythe1628
comments.text: I loved Tunisia. We stayed  in Hammemet and took trips to the Roman Bath ruins, Baths of Antoninus in Carthage, amazing and then to the Bardo National Museum. The mosaics and history were amazing. We went to a Medina market and was able to visit an old house which is now like a Museum  to show how Tunisian families lived. It was so lovely. I would love to go back but to an area where you can go out at night for a walk from your hotel. ❤❤
